i started a month ago started 2.5 . recent patch of 2.6.

hear me out that i spent quite some money because i did enjoy it in 2.5 i think it wasn't too horrible. even older units gave value, story was meh, but the combat wasn't braindead it was the fun kind of challenge. sure. i was happy with that.

THEN immediately on 2.6 patch came out. then suddenly the units i pulled for had absolutely LOW value, weak on the updated endgame. like WHY? why inflate game modes, change rules, cover nerfs as 'bug fixes'? i spent a good sum of money. that's on me sure. but immediately pulling the rug on players?

I pulled for mouchette, i pulled for glotan because that's what's offered on the time i started and suddenly they're absolutely weaker on the updated endgame? that doesn't sound reasonable. so forgive me. DO NOT PLAY THIS game

the dev had to say "it's for the good for overall balancing". devs couldn't just let players have fun. 

WELL THE "BALANCE" MADE MY ACCOUNT SEVERELY WEAKER. THAT'S WHAT HAPPENED. prime example of when the devs start focusing on money and completely forgetting the enjoyment of players

items.title: [负面] I don't usually write reviews but this time I felt...
items.summary:
I don't usually write reviews but this time I felt it was necessary.

I am/was a highly dedicated endgame player with a couple minor achievements to my name with nearly 2 years out of the game's 3 worth of playtime.

TL:DR It sucks. It used to be this highly rewarding teambuilding deckbuilder but the devs have consistently been killing the game for the past 6 months. Every patch has made the game worse than the last but the most recent, 2.7 was the most egregious. It reworked the only fun and primary endgame mode (D-Zone) from an interesting challenge to an inaccessible grindfest. They 10x enemy HP bars, doubled their dmg, and instituted anti-player agency and anti-fun mechanics. The devs have announced they are satisfied with these changes and similar updates will be released in the future. 

It is clear the game's direction is simply not going to be fun anymore and is already in a state where playing feels like a chore and a mandate. A shame cause Morimens had great potential but the dev team squandered it.

items.title: [负面] the game used to be fun until a last dtide change(...
items.summary:
the game used to be fun until a last dtide change(dtide is the endgame of morimens):
prior to release the main dev was gathering feedbck, after which he said the difficulty of the new dtide will be toned down. the chinese and english comunity made the calculations of what that means: the chinese expected 20 million hp bosses(which is extremely hard to do unless you are a whale), the english comunity expected 8-10 millions(that means a double in hp of the bosses and mobs for endgame, compared to old dtide). 

then the update happened. the hp of the bosses reached 45 millions, which makes it that only 5 characters in the game can clear, and only if they have strong supports and they are whaled out. 

the bar for new players was raised as well. basically new players are locked out of the mode. the mode that is the only source of materials required to upgrade our characters enough to be able to clear on easiest difficulty. yes, "you need 5 years of experience for your first job".

together with these changes the shop got upgraded in order to make important materials harder to acces.

the wave of recent negative reviews is because of these changes, that make the game not even pay to win(because not even whales can clear endgame. as i said before, only specific comps can clear. if you don't have the 5 dpses needed it's not going to happen, no matter how much money you spent.), but a poor moneygrab scheme without much thought put into it.

items.title: [正面] Buen juego, una trama atrapante y entretenida, aun...
items.summary:
Buen juego, una trama atrapante y entretenida, aunque la traducción con IA deja que desear y tienes que interpretar por tu cuenta quien esta hablando.
La jugabilidad es muy buena y las diferentes mecánicas son geniales y solo requieren que leas un poco, también algunos enemigos tienen sus mecánicas y debes cambiar tu estrategia en medio de la pelea.
La música es una belleza, simple y melancólica, acorde al juego.
Los banner son accesibles y a menos que quieras estar en el top del ranking no necesitas pasar por caja.
el progreso en la historia puede ser lento ya que por lo menos yo al no pagar el premiun subía de nivel muy lentamente, obligándome a hacer otras actividades para poder hacer ciertas actividades para desbloquear contenido.
En general es un buen juego que recomiendo al %100

items.title: [负面] I loved this game, it was fun and engaging and ver...
items.summary:
I loved this game, it was fun and engaging and very F2P friendly unlike a lot of other gachas in todays market
But the recent changes have pulled the curtain back and shown the community that BIAV does not care for the community that has supported them. Nerfs disguised as "Bugfixes", complete game mode reworks that has invalidated most of the current teambuilding and "non-meta" characters and lies that try to gaslight us into believing that this is not the case. All this in the name of squeezing out as much money as possible and turning everyone into whales; not because we love the game but because it's a requirement to earn the highly sought after progression rewards.

This is a terrible direction the game is going in and every response to the community feedback and backlash has been tonedeaf, skirting around the specific issues that we have with the changes; only pulling back some of the changes in very minor numerical ways without addressing any of the major problems that are still there. I would say it is not worth your time to try and start this game and to any current players if you don't quit outright I would advise not to spend any money whatsoever; with the direction this game is going in, no doubt any serious investment you make will be invalidated or powercrept in the name of profit

items.title: [正面] クトゥルフ神話をモチーフとしたキャラクターデザイン・シナリオは個性的かつ美麗で、第一印象から期待通り...
items.summary:
クトゥルフ神話をモチーフとしたキャラクターデザイン・シナリオは個性的かつ美麗で、第一印象から期待通りのものがお出しされ、とても良い雰囲気。
暗くて救われないことも多いけれど儚くも希望がある、そんな話が刺さる人には深く刺さると思う。私がそうだった。
立ち絵なども全身で見ると驚くような造形をしていて、バストアップ絵からいい意味で印象が変わったキャラも多い。もっとよく見せてほしい。
ゲーム性はスレスパライクで、面白い効果のカードやレリックが多く戦略面でもかなり歯ごたえがある。
日本語での攻略情報があまり出回ってないので、分かる人をなんとか捕まえるか、自力で考える必要がかなり大きいが、それも楽しめる人なら問題ないだろう。
ただし、ガチャゲーではあり、いわゆるホヨバ的なキャラとモチーフ武器を引かせる形式であること、それぞれの最大凸が12まであることを考えるとかなり恐ろしい沼が広がっているといえる。
無論、ガチャ石は適当にやっていてもかなりの量を貰えるし、月1で任意キャラの凸素材が貰え、2~4凸程度しておけば十分に能力を発揮するキャラが多いので無課金でもやりようはかなりある。あるが、上を見ると本当にキリがなくなる。

そして最大の問題点はやはり日本語の翻訳がガバガバすぎるところだ。
カードテキストと実際の効果が異なることがザラにあり、またテキストもころころ更新されるので今何がどうなっているか掴むのがかなり難しい。
固有名詞すら翻訳がブレるのでカード名指定やキャラクター名指定さえ読み取るには曖昧なものも多い。
そもそもテキストが正常に表示されないこともよくある。
現在だと、いくつかのキャラクターの凸効果説明が別キャラクターのものになってしまっていたり、かなり問題がある。
私は英語版テキストと見比べることでゲームを楽しんではいるが、そんな苦労をユーザーが負うべきでないことも理解している。
シナリオテキストも途中から機械翻訳で堅くなるので雰囲気を大きく損なっているのだが、これに関しては待てば順次人の手を通した翻訳に置き換えられていくのでまだ呑み込むことができるし、それを気にするならば日本版を遊ぶ選択肢がある(とはいえ、日本版に実装されたシナリオ分の反映はもっと早くしてほしい)が、ガチャキャラクターの性能説明がしょっちゅう誤っているのは何らかの法に引っかかるのではないかと不安になるのでできれば改善してほしい。

総じて、イラストやシナリオの雰囲気は最高だが、以上の翻訳面の難がかなり大きいため、それを承知で遊べるかどうかだと考える
